Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Attached are our standard MSA and the order form (StreamlineAI_MSA_v1.docx, StreamlineAI_OrderForm.xlsx). Procurement asked that we get a runbook for redlines and an expected turnaround so they can align the PO timeline.

- Our signatory for commercial terms is Jason Park (VP Finance) — cc'd.
- We have a standard procurement addendum (Purchase_Terms.pdf) that we'd like you to review in parallel.

2) An estimate for first-pass redlines and an internal owner on your side.

Thanks — looking to move quickly.

Kimberly (onboarding/billing) — request the Exhibit A contacts and preferred billing start date from Streamline so we can populate the order form.
Rishi (legal) — looping you for any front-of-file concerns; please flag anything that needs executive sign-off.

Elena/Jason — quick clarifying Q: is the Purchase_Terms.pdf a mandatory procurement addendum or an optional reference? That will help prioritize review.

Target timeline: first-pass redlines + claim matrix in 3 business days if possible (EOD Thu 12 Mar). If any of the internal owners need more time, call it out here.

Thanks,

2) First-pass redlines (by EOD Thu 12 Mar): produce .docx with inline redlines + separate summary sheet (Redline_approach.pdf + ExhibitA_PartySheet.xlsx).
3) Legal review (Fri 13 Mar): collect Rishi's comments and produce compromise language for the top 3 risk areas.

- Authorized signatory name and title (Jason is cc'd, please confirm).
- Billing address and tax entity for Exhibit A.
- Any mandatory procurement clause IDs in Purchase_Terms.pdf you require.

I'll start a shared drive folder and post a link once the claim matrix is primed.

Elena — is there an internal SLA on redline turnaround on Streamline's side? If you can confirm the PO lead time, we'll align our schedule.
